scoring_notes: Probability heuristic = base_from_historical_renewal_rate * (0.6 + 0.4 * normalized_health_signal) - decay_by_days_to_renewal. Health signals: product-adoption-high, entrenchment, usage-decline, support-tickets-high, compliance-review, engagement-flat, strategic, churn-risk. Manual overrides logged in Notes column.
next_actions_template: 1) Quick objective for outreach (30s): reason for call + 1 outcome we want. 2) Owner prep checklist: latest usage, open tickets, exec impact metric. 3) Ask: commitment / pilot extension / contract change. 4) Follow-up cadence: 3 business days email, then demo invite.
